about: The opening's song, as it is to be sung over the finished picture by a model that sings: an action-anime opening built on her hook, 'Squish Sloppy~♡'. The times are where each part should fall on the picture (120 beats a minute, a bar is two seconds). The takes themselves sang other words (each shot's 'lyric' in opening.json); these are for the films with the song laid over.
title: Squish Sloppy~♡
style: High-energy anime opening theme, J-rock and J-pop, 120 BPM in 4/4 with a driving double-time feel: pounding drums, fast electric guitars, bass, bright synth stabs. Urgent, punchy verses; a big anthemic chorus with gang shouts on the hook 'Squish, Sloppy!'; the feeling of a fight about to start. Lead vocal: a cute, high, youthful anime-girl singing voice, smug, bratty and teasing, sing-song but forceful, with real pitch and energy. Sung in English. No long intro: the voice comes in within six seconds. About ninety seconds, ending on a hard final hit right after the last word.
tags: anime opening, j-rock, j-pop, 120 bpm, high energy, driving drums, fast electric guitar, synth stabs, anthemic chorus, gang shouts, female vocal, cute high youthful voice, bratty, teasing, powerful, english

sections.picture: her day off goes wrong: the stroll, the book on her head, the words loose, the empty cone, the take-off
lines: One day off, mint ice cream, sun on the street,
then a book hit my head and swept me off my feet.
Pages tore, the words ran wild and free,
and somebody owes a scoop of mint to me.
Wings spread wide, I'm done being nice:
every word as written, I won't say it twice!

lines: Squish, Sloppy~♡ Try and stop me!

Word for word, I'm breaking through,
Squish, Sloppy~♡ I'm coming for you!

lines: Five of us running down the final line,
every -nim, every -ssi, I keep them, they're mine.

not bad, for you, Sloppy~♡
